summary_for_principal:
This is design only — no code changed, nothing to test or approve for risk. You asked me to design solutions for the remaining known gaps; I have, as three work packages ready to build.

Running several pieces of work at once: reuses a pattern already built and proven elsewhere in this system, rather than inventing a new one — the biggest and most involved of the three.

Calling an external service, and running several small tools as one unit: two related gaps, closed by the same reasoning applied twice.

Three smaller, independent items: one kind of approval gate, extending a claim's lease while work is still genuinely in progress (the mechanism already exists, unused, cheap to switch on), and closing the remaining half of a check from earlier this week.

Each comes with what to build, how to test it, and in what order — ready to hand to a future pass, or to start now if you want.
